Ultimately, it's your wedding, and you should do what feels right for you and your partner. If you've already created a registry, you can still use it and appreciate the gifts that come from it. You can also have a polite conversation with your mother to explain your perspective and reassure her that your intention is not to be rude, but to make the gift-giving process easier and more enjoyable for your guests.
